label: early-episode rewarded D1 while the policy leans to a2
explanation: Fires almost only at D1 (97% of mass) when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew=1), and only in the first ~20 trials of an episode (none after trial ~29). It is almost exclusively when the agent is in an a2 regime: the previous choice and the upcoming choice are a2 (100% of mass on action=2, 0 activations at stay=0), mostly in episodes that started with S2 good. The recorded predicate uses only observed or computed quantities: phase, reward input, episode trial, and the model own D1 policy logit choice < -1.52, which leans to a2. Upcoming action==2 gives a similar F1 (0.67) but the agent computes it itself. Dev F1 0.75, mass recall 0.96. Magnitude is tiny (max 0.004 above threshold). In the example windows it is largest on the first rewarded D1 of a run of a2 choices and decays over consecutive rewarded a2 trials. It never fires at GO, on unrewarded D1, in a1 regimes, or late in the episode. Weak D2 activations (3%) appear on a2->S2 common trials. Precision is limited (0.64) because many early rewarded a2 D1 steps stay below threshold. Read it as a slow early-episode drift in this gate, not a crisp task variable.
